UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated WayReel user profile document storing account ownership anchor.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was last updated.

Trip.title: Trip
Trip.description: A user-created trip bucket such as 'Lisbon, March' for grouping saved places.

name.description: Short trip title such as 'Lisbon, March'.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when trip was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when trip was last updated.

Place.title: Place
Place.description: A travel place extracted from an Instagram Reel/post caption, hashtags, or user-provided media.

name.description: Name of the restaurant, cafe, landmark, or spot.

coordinates.description: Latitude and longitude object { lat, lng }, or null if unresolved.

coordinatesApproximate.description: True when coordinates were estimated by Gemini instead of a geocoding API.

category.description: Place category such as Cafe, Restaurant, Landmark.

note.description: One-line note explaining why the place was saved.

tags.description: Bounded list of up to 15 short tags.

visited.description: Whether the user has visited this place.

tripId.description: Associated Trip document ID, or empty string if unassigned.

tripName.description: Denormalized Trip name for display, or empty string.

sourceLinks.description: Bounded list of up to 20 source URLs preserved when duplicates merge.

extractionSource.description: Where in the Reel/post the place was identified.

dateAdded.description: Server timestamp when the place was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the place was last updated.

/users/{userId}/trips/{tripId}.description: User's saved trips for grouping places.

/users/{userId}/places/{placeId}.description: User's saved travel places extracted from Reels and posts.
